detail.longDescription: I am working with Git Bash and want to ensure I follow standard best practices for managing local changes and syncing with a remote repository without introducing merge conflicts. Specifically, what is the core sequence of Git commands for: Initializing or cloning a project repository. Checking repository status and staging specific files versus tracking all modified files. Committing staged changes with meaningful messages. Fetching and pulling updates from a remote target branch before pushing. Environment: OS: Windows (Git Bash CLI) Git Version: git version 2.49
